submission.justification:
Absorber-F1 at 5 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.111% at 100 GeV, representing the optimal configuration among all 15 tested combinations across three candidate materials and multiple thicknesses (2-10 mm range).

PERFORMANCE SUPERIORITY:
This configuration outperforms all alternatives by a significant margin: 21% better resolution than Absorber-F3 (3.942% at 5mm) and 41% better than Absorber-F2 (5.244% at 5mm). The 5 mm thickness represents a well-defined optimum with clear degradation at both thinner (4mm: 3.244%) and thicker (6mm: 3.377%) plates.

ROBUST OPTIMIZATION:
The recommendation is based on comprehensive testing including coarse scanning (2, 5, 10 mm for all materials) followed by fine-tuning (3, 4, 6, 7, 8 mm for F1). Each simulation used 100,000 events for statistical reliability. The 5 mm optimum reflects the best balance between sampling frequency and energy containment/shower fluctuations.

TECHNICAL COMPATIBILITY:
Absorber-F1 is fully compatible with all system requirements: it can be machined to required tolerances, works with the water cooling system (18°C), integrates with silicon-pad readout and common front-end ASIC, and fits the Q3 decision timeline for prototype preparation.

This configuration delivers the best possible energy resolution while satisfying all project constraints and technical requirements.
